bias.zh: 偏空 · 跌破 10月15日低点

read.en: The Nasdaq ADS fell 6.6% on Oct 16 to $136.49 on heavy volume, closing near the day's low of $136.23; with 70 sessions of history there is no 100-day average yet. It is below its falling 5-day ($149.9), 10-day ($164.5) and 30-day ($179.1) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Sep 28 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 7 ($181.0), and RSI is 28.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 10月16日放量下跌 6.6%，收于 $136.49，接近当日低点 $136.23；上市仅 70 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于下行的 5 日（$149.9）、10 日（$164.5）和 30 日均线（$179.1）下方。MACD 自 9月28日起位于信号线及零轴下方，抛物线 SAR 自 10月7日起看空（$181.0），RSI 为 28。

read.en: The $145.6 Jul 17 pivot and the $137.8 Oct 15 low both gave way on the close. Resistance is $137.8, then $145.6 and $149.9 (5-day average). Support is $133.8 (Aug 7 low), then $124.8 (Jul 29 low, the lowest since listing). A close below $133.8 would open $124.8. Switch to the Seoul listing above for the longer trend.
read.zh: $145.6 的 7月17日转折点和 $137.8 的 10月15日低点均于收盘失守。阻力为 $137.8，其次 $145.6 和 $149.9（5 日均线）。支撑为 $133.8（8月7日低点），其次 $124.8（7月29日低点，上市以来最低）。若收盘跌破 $133.8，下一目标看 $124.8。如需观察更长周期趋势，可切换至上方的首尔上市股票。

bias.zh: 偏空 · 守住 7 月低点

read.en: SK hynix closed at ₩1,272,000 in Seoul on Oct 16, up from ₩1,262,000, trading between ₩1,247,000 and ₩1,325,000. It is below its falling 5-day (₩1,333,600), 10-day (₩1,529,100) and 30-day (₩1,690,133) averages, the 100-day (₩1,910,620) and the rising 200-day (₩1,460,420). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 6 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Sep 29 (₩1,635,732), and RSI is 26.

The close held above the ₩1,246,000 Jul 29 low for a second session. Resistance is ₩1.33 million (the last two highs, 5-day average), then ₩1.37–1.40 million (Aug 11 and Oct 14 lows) and ₩1,460,420 (200-day). Support is ₩1,238,000–1,246,000 (Oct 15 and Jul 29 lows), then ₩1.2 million and ₩1,060,000 (Mar 18 high). A close below ₩1,238,000 would open ₩1.2 million.
